title: Trump nominee refuses to call Jan 6 an ‘attack’ at Senate hearing
text:
NewsFeed

Trump nominee refuses to call Jan 6 an ‘attack’ at Senate hearing

Michael LoSapio, Trump’s nominee to lead the US agency responsible for election security, refused to describe the January 6 Capitol insurrection as an attack during his Senate confirmation hearing and declined to say who won the popular vote in the 2020 presidential election.
